verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a meeting-transcription SaaS, since vendors in this category can offer on-prem or private deployments. Nothing in the evidence shows Otter offers one: every documented capability (MCP server, API, S3/Drive export, SSO) runs on Otter's cloud service. Community comments say recordings are retained in Otter's cloud and wish for a self-hosted alternative.
